Name: Mine Skip Rewards
Author: Jean01
Description:
[b][size=4]Mine Skip Rewards[/size][/b]

Get loot from the floors you skip instead of walking away empty-handed.

Mine Skip Rewards simulates mining rocks and defeating monsters on the floors passed over by a forward jump. It works in the regular Mines and Skull Cavern, with loot based on generated floor contents and the game's drop routines.

[size=4][b]HOW IT WORKS[/b][/size]

Jumping from the entrance to floor 5 rewards floors 1-4. The floor you land on is not counted. One-floor moves, upward travel and standing on the same floor do not give rewards.

The mod processes skipped floors after travel and opens a collection menu when the loot is ready. Items are sorted alphabetically. Take individual stacks or use Collect all; anything that doesn't fit stays in the menu while you remain in the mine.

[b]Claim your rewards before leaving[/b]. Returning to the entrance, leaving the mine discards unclaimed loot and unfinished processing. Items already in your backpack stay yours.

There is no daily limit, and repeated jumps can earn rewards again.

[b][size=4]FEATURES[/size][/b]

- Rock and monster loot from generated skipped floors.
- Different floor contents for the Mines and Skull Cavern.
- The game's drop routines, including relevant luck and equipment effects.
- Alphabetically sorted rewards with individual collection and Collect all.
- Controller navigation in the rewards menu.
- Separate rewards for each installed player.

[b][size=4]REQUIREMENTS[/size][/b]

Stardew Valley 1.6.15.
SMAPI 4.5.2 or newer: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400[/url]

[b]Optional[/b]: Skull Cavern Elevator, if you want an elevator in Skull Cavern:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/963]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/963[/url]

[b][size=4]INSTALLATION[/size][/b]

1. Install SMAPI and follow its setup instructions.
2. Download the main Mine Skip Rewards file using Manual Download.
3. Extract the ZIP.
4. Move the MineSkipRewards folder into your game's Mods folder.
5. Launch the game through SMAPI.

[b][size=4]CONTROLS
[/size][/b]
[b]Mouse[/b]: select a stack or a menu button.
[b]Keyboard[/b]: F8 reopens rewards while you are on a supported mine floor.
[b]Controller[/b]: D-pad or left stick to navigate, confirm to select, cancel to close. Shoulder buttons change pages. Use the game's controller cursor-snapping setting.

[b][size=4]MULTIPLAYER[/size][/b]

Every player who wants this mod's rewards must install the same build and launch through SMAPI.

Each installed player gets their own rewards and menu. One player leaving the mine does not clear another player's rewards.

Tested in single-player and with two connected game instances on one computer.

[b][size=4]SCOPE AND COMPATIBILITY
[/size][/b]
Supports regular Mines floors 1-120 and Skull Cavern. Quarry Mine and Volcano Dungeon are excluded.

Rewards do not grant mining/combat experience, quest progress or monster-slayer credit.

Large jumps can still take a moment to process. Other mods that change floor generation, drops or monster death behavior may affect the results. Mods using F8 may compete for the shortcut.

[b][size=4]UNINSTALLATION[/size][/b]

Close the game and remove the MineSkipRewards folder from Mods.
